bootstrap.rule: Size full run after timed analysis pilot; these are paired-row sensitivity intervals, exact finite-population audit intervals supplied separately.

fresh_target.description: accuracy outside entire frozen 512-question selection pool

selection_repeats: uniform distinct subsets without replacement from search pool; rerun selection with independent uniform ties
cache_target: exact mean over all generated question rows; iid with replacement whole-row resampling; separate from genuinely disjoint audit
decision: prespecified interval-nonoverlap superiority rule versus default; audit sign disagreement descriptive, exact paired finite-population interval separately
reporting_comparisons: equal call split in known-truth cache calibration
shard_schedule: sequential 6144-response question shards, no concurrent large inference jobs
rationale: Tier A at the selected 1.5B model requires 173.9h including twofold timing and 48h reserve, exceeding even a full week; B fits. 0.5B was downloaded but not piloted or selected; no main accuracy informed model/tier choice.
stopping_rule: Throughput/resource-only checkpoints; never inspect accuracy for stopping. If remaining twofold cost fails deadline minus 48h, preserve caches and request recorded scope revision. A fixed Tier C fallback uses the first completed even-position question shard (256 search/512 audit) and first 4 frozen-prefix candidates, recording all extra calls; never choose by outcomes.
